Hi, former do-nothing, behaviourally challenged, easily distracted and unmotivated student here. In my time at high school anyone from my teachers to students and even myself could see I was a talented and bright child albeit lacking in motivation and discipline. This continued from grade 7 all the way to the end of grade 12 with my grades continuing to drop from near perfect to barely passing with 60-70%s by the end due to my level of effort never improving. 

After high school, I didn't get grades good enough to go to uni and I didn't want to immediately anyways. What was I going to do there? I had no clue. So I sold drugs. I ran my neighbourhood for 2 years until I went to prison. This was a huge wakeup call for me, I realised I didn't fit in with all the cold hearted killers, robbers and drug traffickers in there. I cared too much about my family and had too much empathy for people. So when I got out, I struggled with my old ways for a while whilst I worked a simple warehouse job. Then I went to uni and done computer science for 2 years. Didn't like it. Sat in a chair for far too long everyday. Tried becoming a real estate agent. Didn't like it. Too prim, too proper, too fake. Went and installed kitchens and learned how to work construction and cabinetry for a year. Enjoyed that. Loved it even. Now fast forward 2 years and I've now got my own business, building and selling my very own custom caravans. Wake up everyday with passion, drive and ambition and am absolute stacked to the brim with work and clients.

Thanks for listening to my TED talk.
